page.title: UPSCALR – upscale images locally
page.description: AI upscaling for photos, drawings and illustrations – right in your browser. Your images never leave your computer.

start.title: Drop an image here
start.or: or paste it from the clipboard (Ctrl+V)
start.formats: PNG · JPEG · WebP · AVIF · GIF · BMP
start.privacy: Everything runs locally in your browser – your images never leave your computer.

drop.title: Drop the image
drop.hint: It is processed only here in your browser.

panel.smoothingHint: How strongly the fast model smooths noise and fine texture (skin, fabric)
panel.grainHint: Fine noise against smooth, waxy surfaces – can be changed after upscaling without computing again
panel.tooLarge: Too large for {factor}× – the browser handles at most {max} px per side and {mp} megapixels.
panel.needCutout: At 1× there is only something to do when the background is removed.
panel.sharpenHint: For soft photos (e.g. from a phone): removes blur and works at the real resolution before upscaling – only when the photo is soft. Fast: after shrinking; Thorough: at full size (slower, more natural).
panel.sharpenSharp: Photo is sharp – no sharpening needed

noWebgpu.title: No WebGPU available
noWebgpu.message: Upscaling runs on the processor and takes much longer. It is fastest in a current Chrome or Edge.

noModels.title: AI models missing
noModels.message: The models have not been generated yet (npm run models).

read.title: Cannot read the file
read.message: The browser could not load {name}. Please pick it again – if the photo is only in the cloud, save it to the device first.

decodeRun.title: Cannot process the image
decodeRun.message: The browser could not decode {name} right now – usually it is out of memory. Close other tabs and start again.

decode.title: Cannot open the image
decode.message: The browser cannot read this format: {name}

formatFallback.title: Saved as {format}
formatFallback.message: This browser cannot write {format} – the result was saved losslessly as {target}.

tileReduced.title: Smaller tiles
tileReduced.message: Not enough graphics memory – continuing with tiles of {size} px.

error.title: Upscaling failed
error.download: The model could not be loaded. Please check your connection.
error.model: The model cannot be started on this device.
error.gpu-memory: Not enough graphics memory, even for the smallest tiles.
error.too-large: The result is too large for the browser's memory. Please choose 2× or a smaller image.
error.encode: The file could not be written – the result is probably too large for the browser. Please choose 2×.

alphaFormat.title: Saved as {format}
alphaFormat.message: {format} cannot store transparency – the cut-out picture was saved as {target}.

cpuFallback.title: Partly running on the processor
cpuFallback.cutout: This browser cannot run the background removal model on the graphics card – it runs on the processor instead (a bit slower).
cpuFallback.upscale: This browser cannot run the model on the graphics card – it runs on the processor instead (much slower).
cpuFallback.select: This browser cannot run the click selection on the graphics card – it runs on the processor instead (slower).
cpuFallback.deblur: This browser cannot run the sharpening model on the graphics card – it runs on the processor instead (much slower).

soft.title: Soft photo detected
soft.message: This photo holds less detail than its pixel count suggests – typical for phone photos. Sharpening removes blur and works at the real resolution; the result gets much clearer.

sharpenConsent.title: Load the sharpening model?
sharpenConsent.message: Sharpening loads a model once ({size}) and keeps it in the browser. It comes from this site – your pictures never leave your computer.

about.title: About
about.description: AI upscaling and background removal for photos, drawings and illustrations – entirely local in your browser, your images never leave your computer.
about.author: Author
about.openSource: UPSCALR is built on great open-source projects. Thanks to everyone who contributes to them!

libs.ort: Runs the AI models on the graphics card (WebGPU) or the processor (WebAssembly)
libs.coi: Cross-origin isolation on static hosting (several processor cores)
libs.realEsrgan: Weights of the photo and drawing models (converted to ONNX for the browser)
libs.birefnet: Background removal: detects and removes the background (ready-made ONNX export)
libs.sam: Click selection: detects the object under the pointer (ready-made ONNX export)
libs.nafnet: Sharpening: removes blur from soft photos (weights converted to ONNX)

edit.title: Edit selection

hint.add: Click an object to add it to the selection. Alt+click takes it out.
hint.sub: Click an object to take it out of the selection. Alt+click adds it.
hint.pan: Drag to move the picture. Holding the space bar does this with any tool.
hint.keep: Paint over areas that should stay.
hint.remove: Paint over areas that should go.
hint.edge: Paint over fine edges like hair or fur – they are refined more precisely there.

status.analysing: Analysing the picture for click selection …
status.failed: Click selection unavailable – the brushes still work.

edit.selectLoading: Click selection is still loading – one moment.
edit.clickFailed: The object could not be selected.
